highlights.body: Combine files, separate ranges, extract pages, remove pages, and correct orientation without rebuilding the document from scratch.

highlights.title: Convert Documents

highlights.title: Review Before Sharing

faqs: Can I merge multiple PDFs into a single document?
Yes. The Merge PDF tool combines multiple files and preserves the order you set before downloading the result.
Does PDF to Word preserve the exact design?
Not always. Conversion prioritizes recovering editable text; complex columns, tables, and special fonts may need adjustments.
Do all PDF operations work the same?
No. Some are processed locally, while others are in beta or use a browser flow. Each tool's card explains its scope.

categories.name: Images

categories.h1: Online tools for compressing, converting, and preparing images
categories.description: Compress, resize, crop, and convert images between JPG, PNG, and WebP. Explore Prisma Space's image tools and options.
categories.intro: An image may need less weight for a website, different dimensions for a publication, or a different format to maintain transparency or compatibility. Here, you can choose an operation based on the result you're looking for, review its options, and download a copy without confusing compression, cropping, and conversion.

highlights.title: Reduce Weight
highlights.body: Adjust compression to facilitate sending or uploading images, comparing the result with the original.

highlights.title: Change Size and Format
highlights.body: Resize by dimensions, crop the frame, or convert between compatible formats like JPG, PNG, and WebP.

highlights.title: Prepare and Review
highlights.body: Add watermarks, create mosaics, check metadata, or remove EXIF information before sharing a photograph.

faqs: Is compressing and resizing an image the same?
No. Compressing aims to reduce file size; resizing changes the number of pixels. You may need one or both operations.
Is WebP always better than JPG?
WebP may reduce weight in many cases, but the best option depends on compatibility, transparency, and required quality.
Can I remove a photo's location?
The metadata tool allows you to clear EXIF information from the image. Review the final file before sharing it.

highlights.title: Image and Creativity

highlights.title: Voice and Content

No. Some functions are in beta, may require a personal key, or depend on provider credits and limits.
Does Prisma guarantee that an AI response is correct?
No. The AI can be wrong or invent data. Verify important information and do not use an unreviewed output as professional advice.
Can I generate images and audio from Prisma?
There are creative tools for image and voice, but each has its own requirements and availability, which are shown in its tool.

highlights.title: Convert and Adjust

highlights.title: Extract and Prepare
highlights.body: Capture a frame, generate a GIF, or separate audio from a video to reuse it in another workflow.

faqs: Can I process any video size?
There is no universal compatibility. Large files may require more memory and time; try first with a small fragment.
Are the multimedia tools in production-ready state?
Several operations are in beta. The card for each tool indicates its status, and you should check the result before using it.
Does Prisma replace a professional editor?
No. These tools resolve specific operations; they do not offer multi-track editing or a complete professional workflow.

highlights.title: Clean and Normalize
highlights.body: Remove blank lines, repeated spaces, diacritics, or duplicates, and apply case changes as needed.

highlights.title: Extract Information
highlights.body: Identify emails, links, phone numbers, or hashtags within a block of text and preserve the result in a list.

highlights.title: Convert Structures
highlights.body: Encode Base64 or URL, work with HTML and Markdown, and transform CSV and JSON in the supported directions.

faqs: Is the text sent to a server?
Local utilities run in the browser. In any connected operation, consult the description and conditions for that tool.
Can I process long texts?
It depends on browser memory and the operation. For extensive documents, divide the content and check the result.
Do the tools change the original text?
They work on an input and generate an output; preserve a copy of the original if you need to compare or revert changes.

highlights.body: Solve percentages, expressions, date differences, time zones, currencies, and units with explicit inputs.

highlights.title: Create Codes
highlights.body: Generate QR codes and barcode codes from the data you want to represent and check the result before printing it.

highlights.title: Verify details
highlights.body: Check color contrast, palettes, and other practical values for design and daily work.

faqs: Does the currency converter use real-time rates?
Check the date and source shown by the tool. Reference exchange rates may be delayed and do not equate to a bank quote.
Can QR codes be used commercially?
You can download the result, but verify that the encoded content is correct and the destination remains available.
Do the calculators replace professional reviews?
No. For financial, tax, medical, or legal decisions, verify the results with suitable sources and professionals.

highlights.title: Format and validate

highlights.title: Inspect and test
highlights.body: Decode the readable part of a JWT, test regex patterns, and generate hashes to compare files.

highlights.title: Explore resources
highlights.body: Query public APIs and discover open-source projects. Review permissions, limits, and documentation before integrating a service.

faqs: Does decoding a JWT verify its signature?
No necessarily. Decoding allows you to inspect the readable content; it does not demonstrate that the token is authentic or valid.
Can I send private keys to the tools?
No. Do not paste passwords, active tokens, private keys, or secrets in public tools.
Do the utilities replace project testing?
No. They are point-specific aids. Validate code in your environment, with your dependencies, and automated tests.

highlights.body: Review structure, headers, and basic metrics to detect issues before proceeding with analysis.

highlights.title: Convert formats
highlights.body: Transform CSV to JSON, JSON to CSV, and use available Excel converters to exchange data between tools.

highlights.title: Validate structures
highlights.body: Check schemas and compare JSON objects when you need to detect differences between versions.

faqs: Are all Excel types and formats preserved?
Not always. Conversions depend on the format and tool; check sheets, formulas, and data types after exporting.
What should I review before converting CSV?
Confirm the delimiter, headers, encoding, and whether fields contain commas or line breaks.
Can I use the output as a definitive database?
No without validation. Review duplicates, required fields, formats, and values before importing data into production.

categories.intro: A file may contain more information than appears at first glance: EXIF data, document properties, internal names, or sensitive text fragments. These tools help inspect and clean compatible metadata, but do not replace a comprehensive review of the content before sharing it.

highlights.title: Inspect Files
highlights.body: Check the file type and visible properties to understand what you're about to share.

highlights.title: Review Metadata
highlights.body: Verify EXIF data from images and PDF properties before distributing them.

highlights.title: Clean Information
highlights.body: Remove compatible metadata from images or PDFs and obscure sensitive data in text blocks, always reviewing the output.

faqs: Does metadata removal delete visible content?
No. Metadata removal does not automatically censor text, faces, license plates, or information appearing within the image.
Does cleaning guarantee anonymity?
No. Identifiable information may remain in the content, file name, history, or context. Review everything before publishing.
What should I do with confidential documents?
Avoid uploading them to external services without authorization. Use local processing when available and follow your organization's policies.

highlights.title: Identify Publications

highlights.title: Organize Study
highlights.body: Explore support functions for study guides, checking their beta status and always reviewing generated content.

faqs: Are generated references ready to deliver?
Use them as a draft. Verify each bibliographic data point in the original publication and adapt the format to your institution's instructions.
Does Prisma guarantee an article exists?
No. Extracting identifiers helps locate references, but you must check that the DOI, PMID, or arXiv corresponds to the source.
Can AI do my academic work for me?
It can support organization and explanation, but you must understand, contrast, and write your own work following academic rules.

solutions.title: How to Organize PDF Documents Online | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Organize your PDF documents before delivering them
solutions.description: Combine, divide, extract, and number PDF pages to prepare binders, reports, and delivery documents with Prisma Space.
solutions.intro: When a transaction or delivery requires gathering multiple documents, the problem is not just the format: order, pagination, and the ability to review the final file also matter. This guide collects operations to prepare an ordered copy without unnecessarily modifying the originals.

steps.title: Gather the original files
steps.body: Verify that each PDF opens correctly and conserve an intact copy. If the dossier contains sensitive data, review privacy rules before processing it.

steps.title: Order and select pages
steps.body: Combine documents in the required order or extract only the pages that should form part of the delivery. Do not include annexes by inertia.

steps.title: Adjust document reading
steps.body: Correct rotated pages and add numbering when it helps review the dossier. Verify that pagination matches reception instructions.

steps.title: Review the final file
steps.body: Open the complete PDF, verify order, pages, and legibility. Do not consider a delivery valid just because the file has been downloaded.

faqs: Can I join documents of different sizes?
The union preserves the original pages; therefore, the final document may contain different page sizes.
Is it better to delete pages from the original?
Work on a copy and conserve the original. This way, you can recover information if you detect an omission.
solutions.note: Tools resolve specific operations and do not verify legal or administrative requirements for a transaction. Confirm the order and documents required by the receiving entity.

solutions.title: Convert Documents between PDF, Word, and Text | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Convert documents between PDF, Word, and text formats
solutions.description: Choose how to convert from PDF to Word, Word to PDF, or between text formats based on the editable result you need.
solutions.intro: Not all conversions aim for the same thing. Sometimes you need to recover text to edit it; other times, you need to prepare a copy that looks consistent when shared. Choose the workflow based on the original document and review what elements can change.

steps.title: Identify the file type
steps.body: Check if the PDF contains selectable text or if it's a scanned image. A scanned file requires OCR before you can edit its text.

steps.title: Choose the destination format
steps.body: Use Word when you need to continue editing the text; choose PDF when you want to share a read-only or print version.

steps.title: Convert and review the structure
steps.body: Open the result and compare titles, line breaks, tables, columns, and special characters with the original.

steps.title: Preserve the original
steps.body: Save the original version until you confirm that the converted file contains all the necessary information.

faqs: Does PDF to Word maintain the original design?
Not necessarily. Text extraction prioritizes editable text; complex tables, columns, and fonts may require corrections.
Can I convert a scanned PDF directly?
First, you need to recognize the text with OCR. Converting a digital PDF and reading a scanned image are distinct processes.
solutions.note: Always check the converted file before signing, presenting, or distributing it. A conversion does not guarantee document fidelity.

solutions.title: Optimize images for a website | Prisma Space
solutions.description: Reduce dimensions and weight, choose a compatible format, and review metadata to prepare images for the web.
solutions.intro: Large images can increase download time and consume data, but reducing them without criteria can also degrade details. A useful workflow starts by defining the viewing size, choosing the format, and comparing the result with the original.

steps.title: Define the necessary dimensions
steps.body: Measure the actual space where the image will appear. Don't upload a photo with thousands of pixels if the design only needs a thumbnail.

steps.title: Choose an appropriate format
steps.body: JPG is often practical for photos; PNG when you need transparency or crisp graphics; WebP can reduce weight in modern browsers.

steps.title: Adjust compression
steps.body: Gradually reduce quality and compare edges, text, and detailed areas. The final file should be lighter without losing legibility.

steps.title: Check the final file
steps.body: Open the exported image, review its dimensions, and remove metadata you don't need to publish.

faqs: What format should I use on a website?
It depends on the content and compatibility you need. Compare JPG, PNG, and WebP in the real context of your page.
Does reducing pixels always reduce weight?
It usually helps, but the result also depends on the format, compression, detail, and metadata.
solutions.note: Image optimization does not replace a responsive format strategy, suitable dimensions, and deferred loading on the website.

solutions.title: Prepare images for social media | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Prepare images for posting on social media
solutions.description: Adjust proportions, crop, add watermarks, and create compositions for posts and thumbnails.
solutions.intro: Each platform and publication location may use different proportions. Before exporting, define if the image will be square, vertical, or horizontal, protect important elements within the frame, and review how it will look on a small screen.

steps.title: Choose the publication location
steps.body: Determine if you'll prepare a feed post, a story, a cover, or a thumbnail. Don't use a single measure for all spaces.

steps.title: Adjust the frame
steps.body: Crop the image without cutting faces, text, or elements that explain the content. Review safety margins.

steps.title: Add identity if necessary
steps.body: Use a discreet watermark when you need attribution or visual protection; avoid covering important information.

steps.title: Export and check on mobile
steps.body: Open the final file at reduced size and confirm that the text and main element remain legible.

faqs: Does Prisma publish directly to Instagram or YouTube?
No. These tools prepare files; publication is done from the corresponding platform.
Is one image suitable for all social media?
Not always. Check the recommended dimensions and safe zones for each platform before exporting.
solutions.note: Platform requirements may change. Verify the current requirements of the platform where you plan to publish.

solutions.title: Analyze and convert CSV, JSON, and Excel files | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Review and convert CSV, JSON, and Excel data
solutions.description: Inspect tables, review statistics, and transform CSV, JSON, and Excel files before importing them into another application.
solutions.primaryQuery: Convert CSV to JSON and Excel online
solutions.intro: A table file may appear correct but still contain duplicate headers, empty rows, unexpected delimiters, or inconsistent value formats. Before converting, it's a good idea to inspect the structure and confirm that the output preserves the fields you need.

steps.title: Inspect the original file
steps.body: Review headers, delimiters, empty rows, and values that mix numbers, dates, and text. Do not delete columns without confirming their use.

steps.title: View statistics
steps.body: Check the number of rows, columns, and values reported by the tool to detect obvious anomalies.

steps.title: Convert to the necessary format
steps.body: Choose CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV according to the target application. If working with Excel, use the specific converter and review the resulting book.

steps.title: Validate the output
steps.body: Compare a sample of records with the original file and verify that no leading zeros, accents, or separators have been lost.

faqs: Is CSV the same format as Excel?
No. CSV stores tabular text with delimiters; an Excel book can include multiple sheets, formulas, styles, and other elements.
Does the conversion validate data quality?
No. The conversion changes the representation; you must review fields, types, duplicates, and required values.
solutions.note: Do not use personal or confidential data in external services without authorization. Keep a copy of the original file and validate the output before importing it.

solutions.title: File privacy before sharing | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Review the privacy of your files before sharing them
solutions.description: Inspect files, review EXIF metadata and PDF properties, and clean compatible data before sharing documents, photos, or sensitive text.
solutions.primaryQuery: Remove metadata from photos and documents
solutions.intro: A photo may include date, camera model, or coordinates; a document may retain internal properties. Reviewing these data before sharing helps reduce accidental exposures, although metadata removal does not eliminate visible information within the file.

steps.title: Identify the file
steps.body: Check the type and basic properties to know what format you are reviewing.

steps.title: View metadata
steps.body: Inspect the EXIF data of an image or the available properties of a PDF.

steps.title: Clean compatible data
steps.body: Remove metadata from the copy you plan to share and preserve the original if you need to maintain its properties.

steps.title: Review visible content
steps.body: Check that no names, addresses, numbers, or other data remain within the image or visible text.

faqs: Does removing EXIF erase a location written in the image?
No. Metadata and visible content are distinct. If an address appears in the photo, you must edit or censor that part.
Does cleaning guarantee that the file is anonymous?
No. Also review the name, content, context, and any data that could identify a person.
solutions.note: Privacy depends on the complete file and the publication context. For regulated or confidential documents, follow your organization's policies.

solutions.title: Organize study and bibliographic references | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Organize your sources and study materials
solutions.description: Prepare bibliographic references, locate academic identifiers, and organize materials to study with Prisma Space.
solutions.primaryQuery: Tools for studying and creating bibliographies
solutions.intro: A good study routine needs locatable sources and consistent references. You can use Prisma's tools to prepare citations, extract identifiers, and structure a first draft of a study guide, always reviewing the original source.

steps.title: Gather bibliographic data
steps.body: Note authors, title, year, journal or publisher, and DOI when available. Do not complete fields you have not been able to verify.

steps.title: Prepare a reference
steps.body: Select the available style and generate a draft with verified data.

steps.title: Organize the material
steps.body: Extract text from compatible documents or use a study support function when available.

steps.title: Review and verify
steps.body: Compare each reference with the original publication and confirm the standards required by your faculty or journal.

faqs: Are the generated references ready to deliver?
Use them as a draft. Verify each bibliographic data in the original publication and adapt the format to the instructions of your institution.
Can I use AI to summarize bibliography?
You can explore the available support, but verify each statement with the source and declare the use of AI if your institution requires it.
solutions.note: Prisma does not replace bibliographic databases nor verify the existence of a source on its own. The responsibility of checking the reference remains with the author.

solutions.title: Prepare content for YouTube and social media | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Prepare resources for your videos and publications
solutions.description: Organize ideas, prepare thumbnails, extract frames, and adapt visual and audio resources for your content.
solutions.intro: A published video usually requires more than just the recording: title, thumbnail, visual resources, and reusable fragments. This flow combines preparation tools with creative functions in beta, without promising automatic publication or ranking results.

steps.title: Define the topic and audience
steps.body: Write the central idea, the benefit for the viewer, and the video format. Use the content kit as a support to structure a draft.

steps.title: Select a frame
steps.body: Extract an image from the video and verify that the face, product, or action are distinguishable in small size.

steps.title: Adapt the resources
steps.body: Resize images for each location and preserve the original file to create other variants.

steps.title: Review the complete package
steps.body: Verify title, thumbnail, audio, subtitles, and usage rights before uploading the content to the platform.

faqs: Does Prisma publish videos on YouTube?
No. The tools help prepare resources and drafts; you must upload and publish the video from your YouTube account.
Does the AI kit guarantee more views?
No. It can help organize ideas, but performance depends on the content, audience, presentation, and many other factors.
solutions.note: Connected creative functions may be in beta and subject to quotas. Verify music rights, images, voices, and third-party materials.

solutions.title: Edit audio and video with online tools | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Resolve common audio and video tasks
solutions.description: Cut fragments, adjust audio, change formats, and prepare videos with multimedia tools from Prisma Space.
solutions.intro: For a one-time task, you may not need a full editor. You can cut a fragment, extract audio, normalize volume, or change dimensions. Some multimedia operations are in beta and may consume a lot of memory; test first with a copy or a short fragment.

steps.title: Prepare a copy of the file
steps.body: Verify format, duration, and size. Preserve the original for potential future adjustments.

steps.title: Cut the necessary segment
steps.body: Define start and duration with precision and review the result to avoid cutting a word or action.

steps.title: Adjust the audio or video
steps.body: Extract audio, normalize volume, or change resolution according to the goal. Do not apply multiple transformations without reviewing each output.

steps.title: Verify compatibility
steps.body: Play the exported file on the device and application where it will be used.

faqs: Can I edit multiple tracks at once?
These tools focus on point operations; they are not a complete multi-track editor.
Why can a video take a long time or fail?
Size, codec, available memory, and browser influence the outcome. Reduce the fragment or test with a compatible file.
solutions.note: Several multimedia tools are in beta. Verify the result and do not use a single export as a backup of the original.

solutions.title: Utilities for programming, validating, and exploring APIs | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Work with code, data, and APIs from the browser
solutions.description: Use utilities to format code, validate structures, test regular expressions, decode JWT, and explore public APIs.
solutions.intro: When debugging an integration, a small utility can speed up the review of a response or structure. This set helps with formatting, validation, and inspection, but does not replace automated tests or security reviews in the project.

steps.title: Isolate the fragment you want to review
steps.body: Remove secrets, active tokens, and personal data before pasting code or responses into a tool.

steps.title: Order and validate the structure
steps.body: Use the compatible formatter or validator and review the indicated errors.

steps.title: Test expressions and values.
steps.body: Verify regex patterns or inspect the readable part of a JWT. Remember that decoding does not verify the signature.

steps.title: Consult the API and verify.
steps.body: Explore documentation or a public API and validate the response in your real environment before integrating it.

faqs: Is it safe to paste a real JWT?
No. Use test tokens or fictional data; a JWT may contain sensitive information or active credentials.
Does the browser test any API?
No. It depends on whether the endpoint is accessible from the browser and its CORS policies, authentication, and limits.
solutions.note: Do not enter secrets, private keys, or credentials into public tools. Verify the outputs within your own development environment.

solutions.title: Create content with artificial intelligence | Prisma Space
solutions.h1: Create drafts and resources with AI tools.
solutions.description: Explore writing assistants, image generation, prompt improvement, and voice with AI, reviewing the requirements of each engine.
solutions.intro: AI can help move from an idea to a first draft, propose alternatives, or prepare creative resources. To get useful results, define the audience, objective, and restrictions; then review data, rights, and tone before publishing. Prisma's features are in beta or depend on available providers and keys.

steps.title: Define the task and context.
steps.body: Explain the objective, audience, format, and restrictions. Avoid including private information or secrets.

steps.title: Prepare a first draft.
steps.body: Use the text assistant to structure ideas or write a first version that you can review.

steps.title: Create or adapt a resource.
steps.body: When available, use the image or voice generator to prepare a complementary resource.

steps.title: Review before using it.
steps.body: Check facts, usage rights, biases, tone, and sensitive data. Do not publish AI-generated output without human review.

faqs: Is AI-generated content ready for publication?
Not necessarily. Review accuracy, tone, originality, rights, and platform policies before using it.
Do all AI functions have free use?
No. Some are in beta, require a connected provider, or a personal key, and may consume external credits.
solutions.note: AI functions can change based on provider, availability, and quotas. Do not enter confidential data or present generated content as verified information without checking it.

guides.title: How to combine multiple PDFs into a single file | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to combine multiple PDFs into a single file.
guides.description: Learn to combine multiple PDF documents into one, maintain page order, and review the final file before sharing it.
guides.primaryQuery: Combine multiple PDFs into a single file.
guides.intro: Combining PDFs is useful when you have separate certificates, forms, invoices, or notes and need to deliver a single document. Before combining, decide the order and verify that all files open correctly.

sections.heading: Before combining the documents
paragraphs: Rename or identify the files according to the order in which they should appear. If the recipient entity requires a specific sequence, follow that instruction instead of ordering by download date.
Keep the originals and avoid including unnecessary pages. The combination does not review whether the file is complete or meets administrative requirements.

sections.heading: What to review after combining them
paragraphs: Open the resulting file and check the first and last pages, content continuity, and page orientation. If you mixed different sizes, it's normal for the final PDF to retain different dimensions.
If the document contains private information, also review the metadata and visible content before sending it.

steps.title: Open the tool and select the PDFs
steps.body: Add all the documents that should form part of the final file. Verify that you haven't selected a duplicate version.

steps.title: Order the documents
steps.body: Organize the files in the reading or delivery order. Review the list before executing the combination.

steps.title: Generate and download the document
steps.body: Execute the operation and save the combined PDF with an easily identifiable name.

steps.title: Verify the result
steps.body: Open the file and browse its pages to confirm that the order and legibility are correct.

guides.note: Work on copies and keep the original documents. The tool combines files but does not validate the content or requirements of the entity receiving the PDF.
faqs: Can I combine PDFs with different page sizes?
Yes, pages can retain their original dimensions within the same document.
Does merging reduce the PDF weight?
Not necessarily. Combining files may produce a larger document; if you need to reduce it, review a separate optimization tool.

guides.title: How to split a PDF by pages or ranges | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to split a PDF by pages or ranges
guides.description: Split a PDF into smaller documents or extract specific pages to share only the part you need.
guides.intro: Splitting a PDF allows you to separate chapters, appendices, or specific pages without sending the entire document. Before starting, identify the page numbers and decide if you need multiple files or a single PDF with a selection.

sections.heading: Choosing between splitting and extracting pages
paragraphs: Splitting serves to separate a document into parts; extracting pages is more suitable when you only need to preserve a selection. The correct operation depends on how you plan to use the results.
Note that the printed page numbering may not match the actual page position in the file. Use the PDF view to confirm the numbers.

sections.heading: Reviewing the separated files
paragraphs: Open each resulting file and verify that it includes the correct start and end. If a section depends on a cover or appendix, include it in the corresponding range.
Keep the original saved until you've verified all parts.

steps.title: Select the original PDF
steps.body: Load a copy of the document you want to separate and confirm that it opens correctly.

steps.title: Indicate how you want to separate
steps.body: Choose the available split or specify the pages and ranges you need.

steps.title: Generate the files
steps.body: Execute the separation and download the resulting documents.

steps.title: Check each part
steps.body: Open the files and verify that the pages are not incomplete or out of order.

guides.note: Ranges refer to the position of the pages in the PDF. Review the visible numbering before deleting or separating pages.
faqs: Can I extract only three pages?
Yes. Use the extraction tool and select the pages you want to preserve.
Does splitting delete the original PDF?
No, it should not replace your source file. Always keep an independent copy.

guides.title: How to reduce the weight of a PDF before sending it | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to reduce the weight of a PDF before sending it
guides.description: Review options to reduce the size of a PDF, understand what affects its weight, and verify that it remains legible.
guides.intro: A PDF may be too heavy to attach to an email or upload to a form. The size depends on images, fonts, scans, and internal content. Before optimizing, save a copy of the original and define the size limit you need to reach.

sections.heading: What usually increases the size of a PDF
paragraphs: Photographs and scanned pages usually occupy more space than vector text. Embedded fonts, repeated images, and other document resources may also influence the size.
Reducing the weight may involve a loss of quality. If the document contains seals, signatures, or small text, verify that they remain legible after optimizing.

sections.heading: How to evaluate the result
paragraphs: Don't rely solely on the kilobyte count. Open the file, enlarge small text pages, and compare images and graphics with the original.
If the document must meet a specific limit, review the final size in the file properties before uploading.

steps.title: Save a copy of the PDF
steps.body: Keep the original file and work on a duplicated version.

steps.title: Execute the optimization
steps.body: Open the optimization tool and use the available options for the document.

steps.title: Compare size and quality
steps.body: Verify the final size and review text, images, signatures, and seals on multiple pages.

steps.title: Use the file only if it meets
steps.body: If the quality or size is not suitable, keep the original and try another configuration or method.

guides.note: The optimization tool is in beta. No guarantee is made for a fixed percentage of reduction or that all PDFs can be compressed without loss.
faqs: Does compression always reduce the size?
No. Some PDFs are already optimized or contain elements that cannot be reduced significantly.
Can I compress without losing quality?
It depends on the content and method. Compare the exported file and don't use a degraded version for documents requiring high legibility.

guides.title: How to Convert JPG and PNG to PDF | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to Convert JPG and PNG Images to PDF
guides.description: Convert one or multiple JPG or PNG photos into a PDF document and review the page order and size.
guides.intro: Converting images to PDF makes it easy to gather photos, scans, or receipts into a single document that can be shared as a single file. Before converting, decide the image order and ensure the text in each capture is legible.

sections.heading: Prepare the Images
paragraphs: Use JPG or PNG files with the correct orientation and sufficient resolution. If an image is rotated or has unnecessary margins, correct it before creating the PDF.
Order the Images by Reading Sequence. For example, a cover page or an identification page may need to appear first.

sections.heading: Check the Generated PDF
paragraphs: Open the document and review that each image occupies the page as expected. Check that there are no crops, rotations, or text that is too small.
If you need to send a lightweight file, measure its size and consider optimizing a copy after verifying the quality.

steps.title: Select the Images
steps.body: Add one or multiple JPG or PNG images to the tool.

steps.title: Check the Order
steps.body: Review the sequence in which the images will be incorporated into the document.

steps.title: Generate the PDF
steps.body: Execute the conversion and download the resulting document.

steps.title: Review Pages and Legibility
steps.body: Open the PDF and confirm that the images are complete and readable.

guides.note: The conversion places images in PDF pages; it does not automatically recognize text from a photograph. To extract text, you need OCR.
faqs: Can I Convert Multiple Photos to a Single PDF?
Yes. Select multiple images and review their order before generating the document.
Will the PDF Have Selectable Text?
Not necessarily. If the source is a photograph, the page will remain an image until OCR is applied.

guides.title: How to Compress an Image for Sending | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to Compress an Image for Sending
guides.description: Reduce the weight of a photo for email, forms, or messaging and learn to check the quality after exporting.
guides.intro: When a photo exceeds a form's limit or takes too long to send, reducing its weight can help. The goal is not to achieve the smallest file at any cost: seek a balance between size, dimensions, and detail.

sections.heading: Decide What to Reduce First
paragraphs: If the image has more pixels than needed, resizing can reduce the weight without forcing too much compression. If your dimensions are already correct, adjust the format quality.
For photos, it's often helpful to compare JPG or WebP; for graphics with transparency, ensure the destination format preserves it.

sections.heading: Check the Result
paragraphs: Zoom in on text, edges, and fine details. Aggressive compression can produce blocks, halos, or loss of sharpness.
Review the final size in KB or MB and confirm that the recipient's form or service accepts that format.

steps.title: Upload a Copy of the Image
steps.body: Select the photo you want to reduce and preserve the original.

steps.title: Adjust the Compression
steps.body: Modify the quality in moderate steps and compare the preview when available.

steps.title: Resize if Necessary
steps.body: If the image has more pixels than needed, change its dimensions before exporting.

steps.title: Download and Verify
steps.body: Check the weight and open the final image to confirm it remains legible.

guides.note: Compression can reduce quality. Do not replace the original and avoid degrading documents or photos that must retain proof details.
faqs: What Quality Should I Choose?
There is no universal value. Compare the visual result and the final size according to the image's use.
Does Resizing Also Help?
Yes, when the original dimensions clearly exceed the necessary ones for the destination.

guides.title: How to Convert JPG or PNG to WebP | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to Convert JPG or PNG Images to WebP
guides.description: Convert images to WebP for use on a website and review transparency, compatibility, and quality before publishing.
guides.intro: WebP is a modern image format that can reduce the size of many web resources. The conversion is not an automatic improvement for all files: compare the result, verify if you need transparency, and preserve a copy of the original.

sections.heading: Choose the source format
paragraphs: JPG is often used for photographs and PNG for graphics or images with transparency. Before converting, confirm that the original file looks correct and that the destination accepts WebP.
If the PNG contains transparency, check that the converter preserves the alpha channel in the output file.

sections.heading: Evaluate quality and compatibility
paragraphs: Open the exported WebP and compare edges, text, and gradients. A smaller size does not compensate if the result loses details that are important.
Check that the website, CMS, or application where you will publish the image supports WebP. Keep an alternative if you need compatibility with older systems.

steps.title: Compare the file
steps.body: Review the quality, transparency, and size before replacing the resource on your website.

guides.note: Compatibility depends on the browser, CMS, and environment where the image will be published. Preserve the original file and test the output on the destination site.
faqs: Is WebP suitable for photographs?
Yes, it can be suitable for photographs and other resources, as long as the final quality is sufficient.
Does WebP preserve PNG transparency?
The format supports transparency, but you must verify that the specific conversion maintains it.

guides.title: How to remove EXIF metadata from a photo | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to remove EXIF metadata from a photo
guides.description: Check what information a photo may contain and remove compatible EXIF metadata before sharing a copy.
guides.primaryQuery: Remove EXIF metadata from a photo
guides.intro: Photos can store technical data such as date, camera model, and, in some cases, GPS coordinates. Before publishing an image, you can inspect those metadata and clean a copy if you don't need to preserve them.

sections.heading: What are EXIF metadata
paragraphs: EXIF is information that some cameras and phones store along with the image. It can include capture settings, date, device, and location, depending on the configuration and file.
Not all images contain the same fields. Platforms can also remove or modify metadata when processing a photo.

sections.heading: What the EXIF cleanup does not remove
paragraphs: Removing metadata does not erase addresses, names, license plates, documents, or faces that appear within the image. It also does not automatically remove file name or publication data.
After cleaning, revisit the copy and review the visible content before sharing it.

steps.title: Inspect the photo
steps.body: Load a copy and check the available metadata to identify fields you don't want to publish.

steps.title: Clean the metadata

steps.body: Save the output with a different name to avoid overwriting the original.

steps.title: Recheck it
steps.body: Inspect the final file and also review what is visible within the photo.

guides.note: Removing EXIF reduces some metadata, but it does not guarantee anonymity. Review the visible content, file name, and publication context.
faqs: Can EXIF metadata include GPS?
Some photos store coordinates when the camera or phone records location. Check the available fields in the file.
Does removing EXIF eliminate the location visible in the photo?
No. If the location appears on a sign, document, or map within the image, you must edit that content separately.

guides.title: How to convert CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to convert CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV
guides.description: Convert tabular data between CSV and JSON, understand their differences, and review delimiters, headers, and values before importing.
guides.intro: CSV represents data in rows and columns using separators; JSON uses objects and arrays. Converting between both formats is useful for moving information between spreadsheets, scripts, and APIs, but requires reviewing how fields are represented.

sections.heading: Preparing a valid CSV
paragraphs: Verify that the first row contains headers, that the delimiter is consistent, and that fields with commas or line breaks are correctly quoted.
Check leading zeros, dates, and long numbers. Some applications interpret these values differently when opening them.

sections.heading: Reviewing the output JSON
paragraphs: In JSON, each row is usually converted into an object with properties associated with the headers. If column names are repeated or empty, the structure may not represent what you expect.
After converting, compare several records with the original CSV and validate that no characters, columns, or values have been lost.

steps.body: Select the file or paste the CSV content according to the available fields.

steps.body: Make sure columns are recognized correctly before executing.

steps.body: Run the conversion and verify that the output contains an array of records with their properties.

steps.title: Convert back if needed
steps.body: Use JSON to CSV to retrieve a table and check the headers and exported values.

guides.note: The conversion does not fully validate the data quality. Check delimiters, types, required fields, and sensitive values before importing.
faqs: Does CSV support nested lists or objects?
CSV is tabular and does not natively represent nested structures. JSON can express arrays and objects within other objects.
Does the conversion preserve leading zeros?
It depends on how values are interpreted. Check identifiers, zip codes, and account numbers as text when applicable.

guides.title: How to review a CSV file before analyzing it | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to review a CSV file before analyzing it
guides.description: Verify headers, rows, columns, and basic statistics of a CSV before importing it into a spreadsheet or system.
guides.intro: A CSV can be opened in a spreadsheet and still contain errors affecting analysis: incorrect delimiters, empty columns, repeated headers, or mixed data. An initial review helps detect problems before transforming it.

sections.heading: What to review in the structure
paragraphs: Check the number of columns, the name of the headers, and if each row maintains the same structure. Observe if there are commas within text fields or line breaks that should be quoted.
Do not confuse an empty row with a missing value. Decide if the data is absent, if the field does not apply, or if it is an error in capture.

sections.heading: What to review in values
paragraphs: Look for dates with different formats, numbers stored as text, extra spaces, and values that should have leading zeros.
Descriptive statistics help recognize patterns, but do not explain the meaning of the data by themselves. Contrast the results with the origin of the file.

steps.body: Select the file you will review and keep a copy of the original.

steps.title: Inspect headers and structure
steps.body: Examine the columns and basic metrics offered by the profiler.

steps.title: Review statistics
steps.body: Use statistics to detect unexpected values or distributions that warrant a check.

steps.title: Correct in a copy
steps.body: Make the necessary adjustments in your spreadsheet tool or editor and re-inspect the file.

guides.note: A statistical profile does not determine if the data is true or if a column is well-defined. Validation must consider the context and project rules.
faqs: Can I detect duplicates with a CSV review?
The review helps inspect the structure, but you must choose a key and a duplication rule suitable for your dataset.
Should I modify the original file?
It is safer to work on a copy and keep an unchanged version for comparison.

guides.title: How to create APA and Vancouver references | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to create bibliographic references in APA and Vancouver
guides.description: Organize data from a source and prepare a reference in common bibliographic styles with a final review.
guides.intro: A bibliographic reference allows identifying and locating the source supporting a statement. APA and Vancouver styles order information differently; before generating a citation, gather publication data and confirm which edition your institution requires.

sections.heading: Data to gather
paragraphs: For an article, locate authors, title, journal name, year, volume, issue, pages, and DOI if available. For books and chapters, also check publisher, edition, and publication data.
Don't invent missing fields. If a source doesn't have a DOI or doesn't publish a date, follow the style and document type rules instead of filling in the data by intuition.

sections.heading: Review after generation
paragraphs: Compare the reference with the publisher's page or the original document. Check author order, punctuation, italics, capitalization, abbreviations, and links.
A correct reference should also correspond to a citation within the text and appear in the final list. Maintain consistency throughout the work.

steps.title: Identify the source type
steps.body: Determine if you're citing an article, book, chapter, website, or other type of publication.

steps.title: Enter the verified data
steps.body: Complete available fields using information from the original source.

steps.title: Select the style
steps.body: Choose APA, Vancouver, or another style accepted by the tool.

steps.title: Contrast and correct
steps.body: Compare the result with the style guide and faculty or journal instructions.

guides.note: The generator prepares references from the data you enter. It doesn't certify that the metadata is correct or substitute the official style guide required.
faqs: Do APA and Vancouver styles look the same?
No. APA often organizes references alphabetically; Vancouver uses numbering according to the order of citation. Check the exact rules of the requested edition.
Can I cite a source without a DOI?
Yes, when the source type and style rules allow it. Don't invent a DOI or substitute data with an unverified link.

guides.title: How to create a QR code online | Prisma Space

sections.heading: Prepare the content
paragraphs: If the QR contains a URL, open the link first and check that it's the final destination. Avoid shortened or redirected links that you don't control.
For text, use a brief string and check that it doesn't include private data you don't want to share with anyone who scans the code.

sections.heading: Test before publishing
paragraphs: Download the code and scan it with multiple devices if possible. Check that the destination opens correctly and that the QR remains legible in the final size.
If you're going to print it, leave a free margin around it and avoid placing elements on the code modules.

steps.body: Save the QR in the available format and avoid compressing it excessively.

steps.body: Test the code from another device before printing or distributing it.

guides.note: A QR code can continue to circulate even if the destination link changes. Use a stable URL and don't encode confidential information.
faqs: Can a QR code open a web page?
Yes. If you encode a valid URL, the camera or reader can open the link when scanning it.
Can I change the link after downloading it?
No in a static QR code. To change the destination, you would need to generate another code or use a redirection service that you control.

guides.title: How to extract audio from a video | Prisma Space

sections.heading: Prepare the video
paragraphs: Check that the video plays and has an audible audio track. If the file is very long or heavy, try it first with a short copy to evaluate the performance.
Not all container and codec combinations are compatible. A file that can't be opened in the browser may require converting it beforehand.

sections.heading: Verify the exported audio
paragraphs: Listen to the beginning, a middle section, and the end to confirm that the track has been extracted in its entirety. Check the format and duration.
Extraction does not automatically improve quality or remove noise. If you need other adjustments, use a specific tool and review each result.

guides.note: Audio extraction is in beta and may depend on the format, device memory, and browser. Respect the original material's copyright and permissions.
faqs: Can I extract audio from any video?
No. Compatibility depends on the container, codecs, file size, and browser resources.
Does the tool automatically convert to MP3?
Extraction and format conversion are distinct operations. Check the output extension and use the converter if you need another format.

guides.title: How to Transcribe Audio to Text with AI | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to Transcribe Audio to Text with AI
guides.description: Prepare a recording, request an AI transcription when the provider is connected, and review names, numbers, and punctuation.
guides.primaryQuery: Transcribe Audio to Text with AI
guides.intro: A transcription converts a recording into text that can be searched, reviewed, and reused. Quality depends on noise, accents, the number of speakers, language, and the chosen engine. In Prisma, this feature is in beta and requires a connected provider.

sections.heading: Prepare a useful recording
paragraphs: Use a file with clear voice and avoid cutting the beginning or end of a sentence. If there are multiple people, identify speaker changes during review.
Confirm that you have permission to process the recording, especially if it contains private conversations, personal data, or third-party information.

sections.heading: Review the transcription
paragraphs: AI may confuse proper nouns, numbers, acronyms, and words with similar pronunciation. Compare the text with the audio before citing or sharing it.
Do not assume that punctuation, timestamps, or speaker identification are accurate if the tool does not explicitly offer them.

steps.body: Execute the function and wait for the provider to process the file.

steps.title: Correct the text
steps.body: Listen to the dubious fragments and review names, dates, numbers, and technical terms before using the result.

guides.note: This feature is in beta and may require a custom key or provider (BYOK), as well as external credits or limits. Do not upload recordings without the consent of the involved parties.
faqs: Is the transcription always accurate?
No. Noise, accents, proper nouns, and overlapping voices can cause errors. Review the text with the audio.
Can I transcribe any duration?
It depends on the provider, file size, and your configuration limits. Check the conditions before processing long recordings.

guides.title: How to Validate JSON Structures and Test Data | Prisma Space
guides.h1: How to Validate JSON Structures and Test Data
guides.description: Review a JSON structure, validate its fields with a schema, and test patterns or formats before integrating data.
guides.intro: When an API returns JSON or a file feeds an application, a small structural error can break the flow. Validating allows you to check that fields and types match what is expected; formatting, comparing, and testing patterns are distinct tasks that should be separated.

sections.heading: Define what the JSON should contain
paragraphs: Before validating, identify the required fields, their types, permitted values, and whether a property can be missing or null. A schema should represent the real project rules, not just the form of an example.
Use test data and remove tokens, keys, or personal information before pasting content into an external tool.

sections.heading: Interpret the results
paragraphs: A validator can detect missing fields or incompatible types, but it does not determine if values are true or if the business works correctly.
After correcting the structure, test boundary cases and validate the response within the application environment.

steps.title: Prepare an example without sensitive data.
steps.body: Create a small sample that represents the object you want to verify.

steps.title: Define or select the schema.
steps.body: Indicate the fields, types, and restrictions that the JSON must comply with.

steps.title: Run the validation.
steps.body: Review the errors and distinguish between syntax problems and structural rules.

steps.title: Test boundary cases.
steps.body: Check for empty values, optional fields, arrays, and unexpected types before integrating the response.

guides.note: Schema validation does not verify the authenticity of a response or replace backend testing. Do not paste credentials, active JWTs, or secrets into a public tool.
faqs: Is validating JSON the same as formatting it?
No. Formatting changes the presentation; validation checks if the data complies with defined rules.
Does decoding a JWT check if it's valid?
No. Decoding allows you to read its content, but the signature must be verified with the correct procedure and keys.
